newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish bonds yields drop, lira firms vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Turkish bonds yields drop, lira firms vs dlr.

text.p: 1020 GMT - Turk bond yields fell around a percentage point on easing political tension and fading cash demand due to tax collections by state banks, bankers said.
* Average o/n money rate leapt to 71.92 pct as mkt opened 75.9 trln lira short, vs Thursday's 52.87 pct when 35 trln lira of bonds matured. Bankers await money rates to ease later.
* Lira firmed vs dollar to 135,460 per dollar from 135,590 prvs close in line with dollar/mark parity.
